body.statement: There exist \(c>0\) and \(P_{0,n},P_{1,n}\in\mathcal M\) with the same \(p_x\), the same \(f_x=f^{\circ}\), and the same two fixed nonidentical asymmetric error laws, such that \(Y\mid(A=a,X=x)\) is Bernoulli under both laws, \(\|\mu_{1,n}-\mu_{0,n}\|_{L^\infty(I)}\ge c r_n\), and \(\|P_{1,n,\mathrm{obs}}^{\otimes n}-P_{0,n,\mathrm{obs}}^{\otimes n}\|_{\mathrm{TV}}\le\eta\) for all sufficiently large \(n\).
body.justification: Freezing the entire unmarked replicate law isolates ADRF uncertainty and prevents the lower bound from being driven by latent-density estimation.
body.gap: The lower experiment of Capitao-Miniconi, Gassiat, and Lehéricy changes the latent density and separates in \(L^2\); Lounici and Nickl likewise perturb the deconvolved density rather than a bounded outcome mark.
body.consumer: The construction certifies that no honest causal band can evade the logarithmic width by estimating the design density or error laws more accurately.
